description: Model Analyses and Guidance is a model or estimator listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Weather Service. This site provides access to maps, animations, and plots of outputs from observational data and weather prediction models. The graphic products can be useful for monitoring development of potential storms. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
